# UnifiedModelingAcrossDomains

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The approach of training a single large model to generalize across multiple time-series and spatio-temporal tasks, rather than task-specific models. This reduces the need for retraining in dynamic network environments, enabling rapid adaptation in TCC/iNEST systems where topology and workloads change frequently.
